reports.title: Experiment Reports
reports.subtitle: Session log · recorded readings · lysis events · CSV export
reports.exportMethodsTip:
Export a formatted Materials & Methods section for use in publications.
Includes cell parameters, exposure protocol, computed values, physical model, and references.
reports.methodsDesc: Generate a formatted plain-text document ready to paste into the Methods section of a paper or grant application. Captures the full experiment protocol as it stands right now.
reports.methodsItem1: Cell model parameters, R, d, εr, σi, Cm, τ, fc for both healthy and target
reports.methodsItem2: Exposure protocol: frequency, field intensity, waveform, duty cycle, pulse width
reports.methodsItem3: Computed values: Vm, disruption ratio, selectivity, steady-state temperature
reports.methodsItem4: Physical model equations and primary literature references
reports.importCsvCaption: Matches CSV rows to log entries by the # column
reports.importCsvTitle: Import measured outcomes from a CSV. Rows are matched to existing log entries by the # column. Filling in any of the measured columns (T-Lysis measured, H-Lysis measured, Viability, Permeabilized, Transfection, Temp, Actual field, Lysis delay, Viability assay, Notes) will attach the reading to that entry.
reports.deleteEntryTitle: Remove this entry from the log. This cannot be undone, CSV exports and methods downloads for this run will no longer include it.
reports.importSummaryIgnored: {n} rows ignored (missing id, not in the log, or no measured data).
reports.importSummaryNoneApplied: No rows were applied. Fill in at least one measured column (T-Lysis measured, Viability, Temp, etc.) before importing.
reports.importError: Could not read the file. Please upload a UTF-8 CSV exported from ResoPulse.
reports.measuredRowsTitle: Number of log entries that have a measured outcome attached via Log Measured or CSV import.
reports.meanTargetDeltaTitle: Mean (measured − predicted) target-lysis residual in percentage points, across all entries with a measured T-Lysis value. Closer to zero indicates the simulator matches bench data better.
reports.meanHealthyDeltaTitle: Mean (measured − predicted) healthy-lysis residual in percentage points, across all entries with a measured H-Lysis value.
reports.meanFieldDeltaTitle: Mean (measured − programmed) field residual in V/cm, across entries with an actual-field readout from the pulse monitor. Non-zero values usually reflect cuvette impedance drift.
reports.totalReadingsTitle: Total snapshots saved this session, auto-logged lysis events plus manually triggered readings
reports.lysisEventsTitle: Readings where target DR ≥ 85% was sustained for the full lysis delay (N × t_p / dc), logged automatically
reports.manualReadingsTitle: Readings manually saved via the Log Reading button in the Experiment Lab
reports.avgSelectivityTitle: Mean of (DR_T / DR_H) across all entries, raw disruption ratio selectivity, not threshold-normalised
reports.peakSelectivityTitle: Highest DR_T / DR_H recorded in this session, identifies the most selective parameter combination
reports.peakTargetRatioTitle: Highest target disruption ratio (DR_T = Vm_T × PEF / V_th_T) recorded, ≥ 100% triggers the lysis timer
reports.freqRangeTitle: Frequency range explored across all logged readings (kHz / MHz / GHz)
reports.fieldRangeTitle: Electric field amplitude range across all logged readings (V/cm or kV/cm)
reports.emptySub: Go to the Experiment Lab and click "Log Reading", or trigger a lysis event to automatically record a session entry.
reports.colSessionTitle: Session: Experiment Session Name The session name active when this reading was logged. Entries from different sessions coexist here, use this column to filter or group readings from separate protocol runs.
reports.tipCellTemp: Temperature: {temp}°C ({cell} cell) Steady-state estimate via Newton cooling: T_ss = 37 + SAR·dc / (λ·c_p) SAR = σ_i·α²·E²·wf/ρ · λ = 0.02 s⁻¹{warn}
reports.colWaveformTitle: Waveform type at time of reading: CW (sinusoidal continuous-wave), pulsed (square IRE bursts), or H-FIRE (bipolar burst IRE). Determines PEF, waveform factor wf, and H-FIRE threshold multiplier applied to the disruption ratio.
reports.colTVmTitle: Schwan transmembrane potential, ≈0 in Resonance mode (see T-Ratio %)
reports.colHVmTitle: Schwan transmembrane potential, ≈0 in Resonance mode (see H-Ratio %)
reports.colSelectivityTitle: Selectivity = targetDisruptionRatio / healthyDisruptionRatio, valid in both IRE and Resonance mode
reports.colTRatioTitle: Target disruption ratio, uses acoustic resonance model for bacteria/virus, Schwan model for cancer
reports.colHRatioTitle: Healthy cell disruption ratio, always Schwan-based (≈0 at GHz for Resonance mode)
reports.colTTempTitle: Steady-state target cell temperature, Newton cooling: T_ss = 37 + SAR·dc / (λ·c_p); SAR = σ_i·α²·E²·wf/ρ (wf = 0.5 CW, 1.0 pulsed), λ = 0.02 s⁻¹
reports.colHTempTitle: Steady-state healthy reference cell temperature, same Newton cooling model applied to reference cell parameters
reports.colEventTitle: LYSIS: auto-triggered when target DR ≥ 85% for the lysis delay period (N × t_p / dc)  ·  MANUAL: saved via Log Reading button
reports.rowSelectHint: Click any row to select it and download its Materials & Methods section
reports.colMethodsTitle: Click any row to select it, then download its Materials & Methods section
reports.colMethodsLegacy: Methods export not available, logged before parameter snapshots were introduced
reports.actionBarLegacy: No parameter snapshot available for this entry
reports.footnote: ¹ T-Vm / H-Vm: Schwan transmembrane potential (mV). In Resonance mode (bacteria/virus at GHz), these are ≈ 0, use T-Ratio % / H-Ratio % as the primary disruption metrics.
